contents:
Every year, the Deggendorf Institute of Technology welcomes international exchange students who, just like I did in my first semester, arrive eager to explore a new country.
Together, we made their first week at the university unforgettable—full of new experiences, friendships, and a warm welcome to their journey ahead.
I was their first contact in the city of many of them, and I loved welcoming them—from picking them up at the station to helping them settle into their dorms. Exploring a new place in the middle of winter can feel a bit daunting, but I made sure they felt at home right away. ❄️✨
Together, we played Schnitzeljagd, explored the city, and turned strangers into friends. New friendships, new connections, and an unforgettable start to their journey! 😊🌍
title: Welcoming exchange students from over 100 countries at the TH Deggendorf

Always curious and eager to grow, I took online courses to level up my coding skills and dive deeper into machine learning and AI. These courses weren’t just about theory—I got hands-on experience, explored real-world applications, and kept pushing my limits. 🚀
Thanks to the Supervised Machine Learning: Regression and Classification course, I gained a solid understanding of the key parameters in regression models and the significance of functions like the sigmoid and logistic functions in various applications. While I wished for a more math-heavy approach, I was ultimately satisfied—walking away with both the theoretical insights and the mathematical foundations behind these models.🚀
Check out my certificate: Supervised Machine Learning: Regression and Classification.
title: Online certificates

contents:
🌐 Welcome to PreproX!
In an effort to optimize my time during busy university days, I developed this web app as a time-saving solution for my machine learning projects. It streamlines the data preprocessing phase by providing an intuitive and user-friendly interface, allowing users to select the necessary transformations effortlessly. The final output is a clean, well-structured dataset, ready for machine learning models.
Our website, developed using Render, is accessible at https://preprox.onrender.com/. Upon visiting, you’ll be greeted with the following interface. The interface is designed for a smooth and intuitive user experience:
📂 Upload Your CSV File Users can upload a CSV file to process and transform their dataset. Simply drag and drop your file to get started! 📊 Data Visualization
Once uploaded, you can visualize your data with interactive graphs and tables to better understand your dataset before making modification ✅ Download Your Processed Dataset
After applying all necessary preprocessing steps, users can download the updated dataset in the ‘Get my new dataset’ section.
🚧 This project is still in development! 🚧
As the developer, I have big plans for PreproX! Future improvements include: 🔹 Rebuilding the frontend with React for better performance and interactivity. 🔹 Adding more advanced data cleaning and transformation techniques to enhance preprocessing capabilities.
title: Prepare your data with  PreproX: Smart Data Preparation

contents:
Prini Bot 🤖 – University Services Chatbot
🚀 A First Step into Team Development:
During my second-semester Internet Technologies course, I worked with a team to develop Prini, a chatbot designed to assist university students with essential services. This was my first experience working on a real project with a team, and it was full of trial and error—but that’s exactly what made it so valuable.
✨ What Prini Does:
✅ Provides information about the menu of the day 🥗
✅ Shares price details 💰
✅ Helps with basic university-related queries 🎓
💻 My Role & Lessons Learned:
I was in charge of the front-end development, where I gained hands-on experience in HTML and CSS. While I focused on the interface, my teammates worked on the back-end and chatbot logic, using Azure for deployment.
This project wasn’t perfect, and I made plenty of mistakes along the way. But thanks to that, I learned some of the most important lessons—especially how crucial communication and a solid strategy are from the very beginning. It showed me that a well-planned approach can make a huge difference in teamwork and project success.
Looking back, Prini was a great starting point, and I’m excited to apply these lessons to future projects! 🚀
title: Prini Chatbot

Welcome to SmartLoan, a project designed to predict loan approval outcomes using advanced machine learning techniques.
Developed as part of the Assistance Systems course in the third semester of the Bachelor of Artificial Intelligence program, this project aims to simulate a real-world financial assistance system that assesses loan applications based on a variety of personal and financial attributes.
With the growing demand for automated decision-making in the banking sector, the need for predictive models that can accurately assess loan risk has never been higher. SmartLoan leverages a combination of regression algorithms to estimate the likelihood of a loan being approved, based on factors such as income, credit score, and asset value.
